description: Stage 2 and Stage 3 container dispatches pass HOLON_REPLAN_FEEDBACK as a Docker -e environment variable, which fails with Linux E2BIG ('exec /home/holon/entrypoint/role_dispatcher.sh: argument list too long', exit 255) when merging a long-lived target branch produces hundreds of KiB of feedback text.
goal: Pass HOLON_REPLAN_FEEDBACK (and any large replan or target-merge feedback text) to planner and executor containers through a mounted read-only file referenced by HOLON_REPLAN_FEEDBACK_FILE (keeping -e environment variables small) across flow/stages/plan_support.py, launcher/containers.py, launcher/env_files.py, entrypoint/planner.py, entrypoint/executor/run.py, budgets.py, config_env_keys.py, env_registry.py, docs/environment_variables.md, and apps/sandbox-executor/README.md (keeping every module strictly within its line budget and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json); still fall back to env var only when small/unmounted, and fail early on the host with a clear error naming the variable and byte size before launching docker if any -e env var exceeds Linux per-variable limits (128 KiB). Add proof tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_replan_feedback_file_dispatch.py covering >150 KiB feedback dispatch. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Resuming parked or long-running flows after main advances produces >200 KiB target-merge feedback that crashes container exec before the agent even starts.
acceptance_criteria: A replan or target-merge feedback larger than the kernel exec per-variable limit (>150 KiB) is written to a mounted file instead of passed via -e and succeeds without E2BIG in planner and executor entrypoints.
Container dispatch fails early with a clear error naming the offending variable and its byte size when an environment variable passed via -e exceeds the limit.

Unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_replan_feedback_file_dispatch.py verify >150 KiB feedback dispatch, entrypoint reading, and oversized -e rejection via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' passes.
Self-explaining code invariant holds: no docstrings, and the only comments are '# why:' comments.

Environment registration and documentation for HOLON_REPLAN_FEEDBACK_FILE are updated across budgets.py, config_env_keys.py, env_registry.py, docs/environment_variables.md, and apps/sandbox-executor/README.md alongside flow/stages/plan_support.py, launcher/containers.py, launcher/env_files.py, entrypoint/planner.py, and entrypoint/executor/run.py.
